svg.title: Available inventory and backordered quantity
svg.desc: Available inventory and backordered quantity. A sales order reaches available finished goods. Enough stock proceeds to shipment and invoice; short stock leads through backordered quantity to a later shipment. Conceptual fulfillment branches. Check the actual order-line and shipment-line quantities and dates; the diagram does not identify one receipt-to-shipment inventory lot.
